## `neuro.symbol.keyFor`

Static method on `Symbol`.

> Returns a key from the global symbol registry matching the given Symbol if found.
> Otherwise, returns a undefined.

## Signatures

```ts
keyFor(input: { sym: symbol; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Symbol.keyFor` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
